title: Total Chaos
tagline: Washed ashore on Fort Oasis — survive the island, spare what you can, and find the way out.
order_note: Sections run in chapter order — Arrival through Resolve — then the merciful run (the five chapter variants plus the good ending), the endings, combat, crafting, and the collectibles. The good ending and the full journal can't be done in one playthrough: a journal in Forgotten sits behind the Protector fight, and killing her locks the good ending out. Plan on at least two runs — a merciful run for the good ending, and a journal run (which pairs well with Survivalist) for the rest.
scope_note: All 37 achievements / 1,000G — the full game, no DLC. No TrueAchievements walkthrough exists; route notes are paraphrased from the Twinfinite good-ending walkthrough (Serhii Patskan, Nov 2025) and TA achievement solutions. About 40–50 hours — and the Survivalist run is the hard part.

achievements.name: Welcome To Fort Oasis
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 1, Arrival — from the beach, through the sewers and the switch puzzles, to the hammer at the end.

achievements.name: Don't Take Your Eyes Off Her
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 2, Decay — through the utility tunnels, the cog puzzle, and the Blue Block access.

achievements.name: They Have Found You
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 3, Forgotten — past the Protector and the flooded hall.

achievements.name: Closure
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 4, Storm — through the Oasis Arcade, Floor 8, and the Connections wall.

achievements.name: All Alone In A Dying World
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 5, Crossroads — the library puzzle (ROWELL – ADLE – MATHOS – ROCA – ELENA – RYTLE) and the secret ladder.

achievements.name: Dragged Down
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 6, Regression — the chasm harpoon bridges, the pump room, and the Tree Lurker.

achievements.name: You Loved This Place Once
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 7, Madness — the Fort Oasis Catacombs and the flooded passages, following the flares.

achievements.name: The Source Of Suffering
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 8, Chaos — Fort Oasis Central, the Hazard Suit, and the mines.

achievements.name: The Solution
achievements.how: Complete Chapter 9, Resolve — the mine, the wired cube, and the forest finale.

achievements.name: I Love You, Kid
achievements.req: Complete Forgotten without killing the Protector
achievements.how: Spare the Protector: lure her to the 'They're gone…' wall so her scream cracks it, then slip out through the secret exit with the fuses. Killing her locks this out for the run.

steps.label: Collect 3 fuses
Lure the Protector to the 'They're gone…' wall twice
Damage her to trigger the explosion that cracks the wall
Kill only the flesh pillars
Ignore the downed boss — use the fuses in the slots for the secret exit

achievements.name: We Keep In Touch
achievements.req: Complete Storm without killing the Forgotten Ones or burning the Connections
achievements.how: Play Storm without killing a single Forgotten One and without burning the wall of Connections — bait them past instead.

steps.label: Skip the save at the record player in the shop
Bait the Forgotten Ones but don't kill them
Don't burn the Connections wall with Molotovs

achievements.name: Thought Patterns
achievements.how: Stay insane for the whole chapter: take the High Dose Medication, answer all four phones, and don't touch a record player after the pills — saving cures the Madness and breaks the route.

steps.label: Take the High Dose Medication from the shelf
Answer all 4 phones
Don't save at record players after taking the pills
Collect all the tapes

achievements.name: Keep Growing
achievements.req: Complete Regression without killing the Tree Lurker
achievements.how: Don't pull any valve until the final one at the end of the level — the Radio Voice will tell you to, ignore it — and spare the Tree Lurker.

steps.label: Ignore every valve except the final one
Spare the Tree Lurker

achievements.name: I Won't Kill Them
achievements.req: Complete Chaos without killing the Forgotten Ones
achievements.how: Take the alternate paths around every Forgotten One in Chaos — killing even one locks this out.

steps.label: Take the alternate paths around the Forgotten Ones
Don't kill any of them

achievements.name: I Was Wrong
achievements.req: Finish Total Chaos by getting the Good Ending
achievements.how: The merciful run: ignore the Radio Voice, spare or bypass every boss and Forgotten One, and do the chapter mercies below. Missing even one locks the good ending out for that playthrough.

steps.label: Ch 1: avoid unnecessary kills
Ch 2: grab Leda's cassette under the graveyard
Ch 3: spare the Protector
Ch 4: spare the Forgotten Ones, don't burn the Connections
Ch 5: stay insane (pills, phones, no record-player saves)
Ch 6: spare the Tree Lurker
Ch 7: find the hidden tape
Ch 8: spare the Forgotten Ones, take the alternate paths

achievements.name: Death Sentence
achievements.how: Finish the game — any ending counts.

achievements.name: Chaotic Excursion
achievements.req: Finish Total Chaos in Survivalist Mode
achievements.how: Finish the game on Survivalist difficulty: far fewer resources, no autosave (you spend disc records to save), and enemies hit much harder. It has a reputation for soft-locks — keep spare saves, and if the Chapter 4 record player freezes you, save with a disc record, quit, and reload. Tip: drop everything before putting on the radiation suit in Chaos, then pick it all back up — equipping it wipes your inventory.

achievements.name: Plenty Of Fish In The Sea
achievements.req: Leave the island with your boat
achievements.how: Do this first: at the very start of a fresh run, walk forward to your boat and leave. It ends the game on the spot.

achievements.name: Try Again If You Dare
achievements.req: Repel a monster attack by parrying
achievements.how: Deflect a monster's attack with your pickaxe — the strengthened pickaxe from the Coastline Bench works for this. Don't kill it if you're on the merciful run.

achievements.name: Nightmare Hunter
achievements.how: Kill any monster. Kills count against the merciful run — do your killing on the journal or Survivalist run.

achievements.name: DIY Explosion
achievements.req: Kill at least 3 monsters with only 1 Nail Bomb
achievements.how: Lure at least three monsters close together, then detonate a single Nail Bomb among them.

achievements.name: Take That!
achievements.req: Kill a monster by tossing a weapon at it
achievements.how: Throw a weapon (a crafted shiv works) at a monster to finish it off.

achievements.name: You Can Kill What You Can't See
achievements.how: Kill a Screamer — the shrieking flyers in the dark areas (the flying monster in Forgotten's flooded hall is the first one you'll meet). Killing it conflicts with the merciful run, so do it on the journal run.

achievements.name: Monster Fishing
achievements.req: Impale 3 harpoons into a single monster
achievements.how: Stick three harpoons into one monster — load the harpoon (picked up in Forgotten) and fire all three into the same target before it dies.

achievements.name: Don't Come Near Me
achievements.req: Escape the first Brute in Arrival without taking damage
achievements.how: In Arrival, avoid the first Brute entirely — don't fight it, pull the switches and hide behind the rolling gate until you can move on. Reload your save if it lands a hit.

achievements.name: Knock, Knock!
achievements.req: Die by being burned by a Slammer
achievements.how: Let a Slammer burn you to death — just stand in its fire until you drop.

achievements.name: Drowning Not Allowed
achievements.how: Stay underwater too long — in Forgotten's flooded sections, don't surface and you'll drown.

achievements.name: Prepared For All Situations
achievements.how: Pick up items until you go over your weight limit — the game will tell you you're overencumbered.

achievements.name: Crafty Miner
achievements.how: Craft anything at a workbench — glass or metal shivs in Decay are the first chance.

achievements.name: Back To Formula
achievements.how: Craft an item that uses a syringe as an ingredient at a workbench.

achievements.name: It's Going To Hit Hard
achievements.req: Upgrade a melee weapon with tape and barbed wire
achievements.how: At a workbench, upgrade a melee weapon with tape and barbed wire.

achievements.name: Winner Winner Monster Dinner!
achievements.how: Cook monster meat on the gas cooker (picked up in Crossroads) — heat it until it's done.

achievements.name: I'm Not Going To Die, Not Yet
achievements.req: Stop your bleeding with a bandage
achievements.how: When you're bleeding, use a bandage from your inventory. Bandages are craftable from Decay on.

achievements.name: Down In My Cellar
achievements.req: Clear your Madness level at a save zone
achievements.how: Let your Madness build up, then clear it at a save zone (a shrine or record player). Note: clearing Madness this way can break the Crossroads insane run — do that one without saving.

achievements.name: Things Best Left Undisturbed
achievements.req: Find the cassette tape under the graveyard in Decay
achievements.how: In Decay's graveyard, break the boards on the ground to reach the secret area underneath and grab Leda's cassette tape. Also needed for the good ending.

achievements.name: I Will Make Good Use Of It
achievements.how: In Decay, drop through the vertical tunnel and pick up Miller's Key behind the rolling gate, then use it to open Miller's storage.

achievements.name: I Know Who I Am
achievements.req: Complete the Journal with everything there is to find in Fort Oasis
achievements.how: Collect all 45 journals: Arrival 5, Decay 8, Forgotten 7, Storm 7, Crossroads 5, Regression 4, Madness 5, Chaos 3, Resolve 1. One journal in Forgotten sits behind the Protector fight — killing her for it locks out the good ending, so the full journal and the good ending need separate playthroughs; combine the journal run with Survivalist to save a run.
